Passwords protect your digital identity. Strong passwords make it much harder for attackers to gain unauthorized access to your accounts. A password should contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers and special characters.
Phishing attacks often arrive through emails, SMS messages or fake websites that appear legitimate. Their goal is to steal passwords, banking information or personal details.
Malware includes viruses, worms, ransomware, spyware and trojans. It can steal data, encrypt files, monitor activity or damage your computer.
Safe browsing includes checking for HTTPS websites, avoiding suspicious downloads, keeping browsers updated and never entering sensitive information on unknown websites.
